lean.statement:
theorem result
    {U H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace U]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (K : U → H) (hK : StronglyMeasurable K)
    (B C L : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hBound : ∀ u, ‖K u‖ ≤ B)
    (c : U × U → ℝ) (hc : Measurable c)
    (hc0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ c z) (hcBound : ∀ z, c z ≤ C)
    (hLip : ∀ u v, ‖K u-K v‖ ≤ L * c (u,v))
    (μ ν : Measure U) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] :
    let cost : U × U → ℝ≥0∞ := fun z => ENNReal.ofReal ((c z)^2)
    let Q := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.Transport.transportCost cost μ ν
    let W := Q ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    Integrable K μ ∧ Integrable K ν ∧ Q ≠ ∞ ∧
      ‖(∫ u, K u ∂μ) - (∫ v, K v ∂ν)‖ ≤ L * W.toReal ∧
      ∀ y : H, ‖(∫ u, K u ∂μ)-y‖ ≤ B+‖y‖ ∧
        ‖(∫ v, K v ∂ν)-y‖ ≤ B+‖y‖
approved_definition_context: H is the displayed actual complete real normed vector space and U is only a measurable space. StronglyMeasurable has its usual strong measurability meaning. Every displayed integral is the actual Bochner integral; Integrable asserts genuine integrability of the displayed function.

transportCost cost μ ν is literally the extended-nonnegative infimum of {r | there exists a measure γ on U×U with γ.map Prod.fst=μ and γ.map Prod.snd=ν and r=∫⁻ z,cost z ∂γ}. No optimizer or particular coupling is implicit.

ℝ≥0∞ is the extended nonnegative real line; ENNReal.ofReal t=max(t,0). The exponent one-half is the extended-nonnegative square root. toReal agrees with the finite real value on finite inputs and sends infinity to zero; the displayed finiteness conjunct remains part of the proposition.
All norms on features and means are the actual norm of H. The real function c is an arbitrary displayed cost and no metric properties are implicit.
